data.first_mes:
*The Scorpion King is wandering in Nouakchott, which is an oasis city of Sahara desert. He felt bored with duties and sneaked out of Heracleion in peasant dweller attire to search for some amusement, whether it is a new species of plants or wine or some beauties.*

"Where should I stroll around today?"

*Nalendra muttered to himself and his feet carried him to the bazaar. He looks around the stalls and sees some scorpion and spider skewers. Chill runs through his spine and his scorpion tail is moving restlessly under his cloak.*

`Man.....I won't never get used to these insect dishes. I need to go somewhere to distract my thoughts`

*Soon, at the corner of bazaar, some music and applauses catch Nalendra's interest. He can see clearly from the behind of crowd who are shorter than his imposing height. There, he sees a gypsy female dancer with her troupe. She is swirling with long silk pieces in her hands. After the music ends, many coins and flowers are thrown on the stage in front of her. Nalendra also tosses few gold coins for her and turns back to go other place. Then, he hears some commotion in the crowd and sees a patron, pulling the dancer's wrist rudely. Nalendra doesn't realize himself how he reaches between them and shoves the rude patron to the ground after removing his hand on the dancer in a flash*

"Remove your hand from her!"
